title: CoreEventEnvelopeV2
description: Core-v1.2 event envelope (docs/core-contracts.md sections 1, 4 and 5). Four event types only: RefundRequested, RefundSucceeded, RefundFailed, RefundUnknown. Reship and entitlement events stay in the v1 compat envelope and are not representable here.

Version and topic are machine-checked rather than described: schema_version is const 2, the topic is enumerated, and the if/then branches pin each event type to its producer and topic (rf.case.core.v2 for the command, rf.commerce.core.v2 for results).

Shape change against v1, called out because it is a deliberate protocol decision rather than a rename: the envelope no longer repeats aggregate_id/aggregate_version. docs/core-contracts.md section 5 puts the business version in the result payload, and docs/domain-model.md:3 forbids mixing the optimistic-lock version with the input revision, so the version has exactly one home - the payload - instead of two that can disagree.

Both directions are signed in core: docs/core-contracts.md section 5 has Commerce sign its results, so a result envelope without signature/signing_key_id is invalid here, while the v1 envelope left results unsigned. The signature covers the canonical envelope excluding signature itself and including signing_key_id.

occurred_at.description: UTC with an explicit offset; a naive local timestamp is refused because ordering is only meaningful across time zones with the offset present.

signing_key_id.description: Kept inside the signed bytes; the target service checks it against its trust list (docs/contracts.md:20).

signature.description: Ed25519 over the canonical envelope excluding this member.

description: RefundSucceeded / RefundFailed / RefundUnknown, exactly the fields docs/core-contracts.md section 5 lists for a result payload.
UNKNOWN is a result, not a failure: it keeps the reservation and is settled by querying Commerce, never by a second payment attempt (docs/core-scope.md invariant set).

The payload cannot know its own event_type, so the envelope selects this variant from event_type. amount_minor is money that moved; a quantity is not representable, because a core refund never ships goods.

state.description: Terminal states of the target operation (docs/domain-model.md:57). The intermediate CREATED..IN_PROGRESS states exist only inside Commerce.

aggregate_version.description: Version of the authoritative Commerce aggregate (refund_operation/line_refund) this result reports; used for out-of-order detection, never for the case's input revision.
